sources.entry: GravityNotch - Turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island with system HUDs that work on macOS Tahoe, a lock screen player with synced lyrics, clipboard history and live Claude Code agent tracking. summary.name: GravityNotch
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source macOS app that turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island-style hub for music, timers, system HUDs, clipboard history and AI agent tracking.
use_cases: Show music and synced lyrics in the notch
Replace macOS volume and brightness HUDs
Track Claude Code agents from the notch
Run a countdown timer in the notch
summary.what_it_does: GravityNotch places a Dynamic Island-style panel in the MacBook notch, or a virtual island at the top of the screen on non-notch displays. It shows music with live lyrics, a lock screen player, and calendar events alongside the current track. It replaces the system volume and brightness HUDs with notch-based ones, and shows AirPods or Bluetooth headphone battery status. Extra tools include a timer, a clipboard history with search and pinning, a Shelf for dropped files (OCR, ZIP, PNG conversion, background removal), a Caffeine sleep preventer, an audio output switcher, and a Caps Lock indicator. The page also describes live tracking of Claude Code agents.
notable: Fork of boring.notch by TheBoredTeam, adding lock screen player, Playing Next, OCR, Clips and Agents
Works on screens without a notch via a virtual island at the top of the screen
caveats: Not signed with a paid Apple developer certificate, so macOS blocks it on first launch and needs manual approval in Privacy & Security
Requires Accessibility permission for volume, brightness and keyboard backlight HUDs
